highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Founded in 1829, Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) is a world-renowned private research university located in Rochester, New York. It’s best known for its strong emphasis on technology, engineering, computing, design, business, and the arts. Plus, RIT offers more than 200 undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across nine academic colleges.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: Your life at RIT is vibrant and diverse. You’ll find a multicultural environment, with students from more than 100 countries. You can explore more than 300 student clubs and organisations as well. What’s more, RIT’s international student services offer you support, including orientation programmes, peer mentoring, career preparation, and more.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
RIT offers a range of housing options to match your lifestyle and budget. Rooms are fully furnished, and you’ll have access to laundry facilities, lounges, study rooms, and student support teams.

If you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The Wallace Library and RIT’s digital resources provide access to extensive journals, databases, and collaborative study areas.

Sports
At RIT, you’ll find many modern facilities, including fitness centres, indoor tracks, swimming pools, courts and fields.

Laboratory
On campus, you’ll also find several specialised labs for Engineering, Cybersecurity and Computing Centres, Biotechnology and Imaging Science labs, and Digital Manufacturing and Prototyping Studios.

Cafeteria
RIT’s dining options include Global Village eateries and coffee shops across campus.
